paragraphs.text:
The pyramid is certainly old, but not very impressive. Do you 
want to walk around it? Y ou can spend one hour examining 
one of its four faces: for North, go to 317; for East, go to 359; 
for South, go to 337; for West, go to 561. Deduct one hour for 
studying each of the four faces; if you study all four, then deduct 
four hours. 
Or you can enter the pyramid by going to the tomb entrance 
on the western side at 390; or return to the village of Tell-el-
Amarna at 324.
(317, 337, 338, 344, 390, 444)
